why: Unit keywords as New Recruit prints them (melee.txt Categories): the only BEAST SNAGGA units are Mozrog Skragbad ("Beast Snagga, Character, Epic Hero, Faction: Orks, Monster, Mozrog Skragbad") and both Beastbosses on Squigosaur ("Beast Snagga, Beastboss on Squigosaur, Character, Faction: Orks, Monster, Warboss"); all three are MONSTER and CHARACTER. No other unit, attached units included (Bigboss unit: "Grenades*, Warboss*, Breaka Boyz*, Explosives*"; Meganobz units: "Explosives*, Meganobz*"), has BEAST SNAGGA. So the condition "within 3\" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units)" can't be met by any unit in this list. The armyUnits keywords match NR (the second Gretchin unit is left out, but it has the same keywords and no BEAST SNAGGA). A checkable list fact; nothing added.

Source: "In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield." The 2+ roll, "stays" (= "do not remove") and the removal "until it has fought or the phase ends" are exact. But the condition is the game term "has not been selected to fight", and the def says "before fighting". That differs in the gap after this unit is selected to fight but before it attacks (e.g. it is destroyed by a rule that triggers when it is selected to fight). The source gives no roll there; "before fighting" leaves the reader to decide. The fix uses the source's term.

fix.def: Destroyed in the Fight phase before being selected to fight: on a 2+ it stays until it has fought or the phase ends

Source: "If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP." Melee attacks are made in the Fight phase. A charge move can be made in either turn (your Charge phase, or Heroic Intervention's "Resolve a charge with your unit" at the end of the opponent's Charge phase). So Fight in either turn, the same as the signed-off Might is Right.

Orks War Horde Enhancements: "Headwoppa's Killchoppa 15 pts / ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn…". NR lists it in the 155-pt Beastboss's options (l.290); the other Beastboss is 140 pts. A checkable fact.

Source: "When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge." Core 09.02: the active player makes fall-back moves in their Movement phase. Core 09.07: "Until the end of the turn … your unit is not eligible to shoot, declare a charge". The effect therefore acts in your Movement phase (the move), your Shooting phase and your Charge phase. The restriction ends with your turn, so nothing in the opponent's turn is affected. This matches the signed-off Turbo Engine (movement + charge, your).
